warm_runs.query: Show all employee names and their salaries.
Find employees in Engineering with salary above 45000.
warm_runs.generated_sql: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE department = 'Engineering' AND salary > 45000.0

warm_runs.query: What is the total salary expenditure across all departments?
warm_runs.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(salary) AS total_salary FROM employees

warm_runs.query: Show pairs of distinct employees who work in the same department.
warm_runs.generated_sql: SELECT e1.name, e2.name, e1.department FROM employees AS e1 JOIN employees AS e2 ON e1.department = e2.department AND e1.id < e2.id

warm_runs.query: Which departments have more than one employee and an average salary over 35000?
warm_runs.generated_sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS employee_count, AVG(salary) AS average_salary FROM employees GROUP BY department HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 AND AVG(salary) > 35000
